## Automation Error Alert

### Introduction
Sends you a Telegram message when any of the five Automation workflows fails, so a failure is never silent.

### What to key in
Nothing. It runs by itself.

### What happens next
1. A workflow fails.
2. **Error Trigger** receives the failure details.
3. **Send Failure Alert** sends the workflow name, failed node, error and a link to the run.

### Setup
1. Publish this workflow, because an unpublished error workflow cannot run.
2. To alert a different chat, change Chat ID in **Send Failure Alert**.
